stem: Chitra has two sticks of lengths $28\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $42\,\mathrm{cm}$. She wants to cut both into pieces of the same whole-number length, using the largest possible piece length with no stick left over.

parts.text: Which claim correctly states what she should find?

options.text: The highest common factor of $28$ and $42$.
Any common factor of $28$ and $42$, even when a larger one also fits.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The largest equal piece length that divides both $28$ and $42$ with no remainder is the highest common factor.

teacher.key_rationale: Largest equal piece with no remainder is the HCF. A common multiple answers a different question; any common factor may be too small.
